title: A Station-Based Evaluation of Machine Learning-based Weather Forecasting Models in Northern Norway
abstract: arXiv:2609.10564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent machine learning weather prediction (MLWP) models have demonstrated remarkable forecasting skill on global reanalysis-based benchmarks. However, their performance remains unclear in challenging environments such as Northern Norway, where narrow fjords and rapidly changing weather result in highly variable local wind conditions. In this case study, we evaluate FourCastNet3 (FCN3), GraphCast, and ECMWF High Resolution Forecast (HRES) for wind speed forecasting using multi-year station observations from Northern Norway, focusing on their relative performance, generalization beyond the training period, and performance under high-wind conditions. Our results show that HRES slightly outperforms FCN3 and GraphCast, with an overall RMSE of 2.89 $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$, compared to 2.96 $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ for FCN3 and 2.94 $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ for GraphCast. translated_title: 基于站点观测的挪威北部机器学习天气预报模型评估
translated_abstract: 近年来，机器学习天气预报（MLWP）模型在基于全球再分析数据的基准测试中展现出卓越的预报能力。然而，它们在具有挑战性环境中的表现仍不清楚，例如挪威北部，那里狭窄的峡湾和快速变化的天气导致局地风况高度多变。在本案例研究中，我们利用挪威北部多年的站点观测数据，评估了FourCastNet3（FCN3）、GraphCast和ECMWF高分辨率预报（HRES）在风速预报方面的表现，重点关注它们的相对性能、超出训练期的泛化能力以及高风条件下的表现。结果表明，HRES略优于FCN3和GraphCast，其总体均方根误差（RMSE）为2.89 m/s，而FCN3为2.96 m/s，GraphCast为2.94 m/s。值得注意的是，机器学习天气预报模型在超出各自训练期后仍保持相当的性能……
tldr: 本研究利用挪威北部多年站点观测评估了FourCastNet3、GraphCast与ECMWF HRES的风速预报表现，发现传统数值模式HRES仅略优于机器学习模型，且机器学习模型在训练期之外仍能保持相当的预报性能。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates FourCastNet3, GraphCast, and ECMWF HRES for wind speed forecasting using multi-year station observations in Northern Norway, showing that HRES only slightly outperforms the machine learning models, which maintain comparable performance even beyond their training period.
